messages:
Rae: Heads-up — saw a surge of fncall validation rejects after we toggled strict-validation on canary-epsilon at 04:40. Sample error: `ValidationError: response.items expected object, got []`.
Hector: Oof. Was strict supposed to be 100%? I thought canary was 1%.
Mona: It was meant to be 1%. Someone mistakenly promoted the flag to full sampling during the rollout job.
SRE-Bot: deploy/canary-epsilon applied at 04:39 (build 2026.03.14-04:38).
Rae: Impact: ~0.18% of requests in ap-northeast, and tracing storage doubled because we capture full payloads for every reject.
Hector: Immediate mitigation: revert sampling to 1%, and set a permissive-coerce fallback for prod routes so callers don't get 400s.
Mona: Agreed. Also need better labels on metrics — currently rejects are just a single counter. Add route_id, model_variant, and strict=true tags.
Telemetry: We'll emit `fncall.rejects.v2` with tags (route_id, model_variant, strict), `fncall.coerce.v2` and `fncall.fallback.used`. Also add an example sampler (1/1000) with PII scrubber.
Rae: Who owns rollback PR? Hector? I can approve quickly.
Hector: I'll open PR "ops/revert-strict-canary-epsilon" now and patch router to add fallback transform -> legacy.
SRE-Bot: incident INC-2026-123 created P2, assignees Rae, Hector, Mona.
Mona: For tracing change: stop capturing full bodies on every reject; sample 1/500 and cap at 64KB — that'll cut retention.
Hector: Rollback merged. Sampling back to 1%. Early checks: rejects dropped to ~0.01%, fallback_used metric visible at 0.12%.
Mona: Captured canonical failing example; filed TASK-534 for model adapter to return items as object. Also adding rollout checklist item: sampling verification, fallback, telemetry with tags, example-scrubber, billing rule.
Rae: Follow-ups: 1) dashboard tile for fncall/validation with reject_rate by route, coerced_count, fallback_rate, 2) billing change to mark reject->fallback as non-billable if fallback completes within 1s, 3) playbook update.
Telemetry: Dashboard ETA 90m. We'll scrub examples (redact emails, mask long numbers, drop ssn/dob). Hash session ids.
Rae: Thanks team. Keep updates here. If any prod reject_rate > 1% we escalate to P1.
Hector: Verified after 30m: stable. Closing incident and creating postmortem draft.
SRE-Bot: status: INC-2026-123 resolved -> postmortem assigned to Rae.
